sub_sector.value: Aircraft avionics and flight deck retrofits

manufacturing_type.detail: Engineers, manufactures, and tests avionics units in-house, including flight displays, autothrottles, and air data computers.

product_complexity.detail: Certified flight decks and precision air data computers support navigation, flight control, and autopilot integration.

production_role.detail: Makes certified retrofit avionics for operators and MROs and supplies avionics directly to aircraft OEMs for new production.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves commercial, military, business, and general aviation across retrofit and forward-fit programs.

notes: The evidence describes platform-specific engineering but leaves build-to-order and stocking practices unclear.
